name: MultiSector
author: bluenerd8
description: Experimental multiplayer for Starsector. Share the host's world, see each other's fleets, and stay on one shared date with shared pause. Use the MultiSector launcher to host or join; F8 in the campaign shows the players. In a star system shared with the host, NPC fleets are shared and can be fought. Markets are shared through the host. Click another player's fleet to talk and trade.
